fusions.name: Sprung Latch
fusions.desc: Flicks a bolt that deals 20 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds, with a 50% chance to turn it against its allies for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Switcheroo
fusions.desc: Deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stuns each for 0.8 seconds, with a 40% chance to turn each against its allies for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Feigned Surrender
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 5 seconds and raises your dodge chance by 25% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Loaded Dice
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a blow that would hit you is rolled a second time against your dodge chance, and the second roll stands.
